verdict.rationale: Brex documents a broad public REST API with token-based auth and scopes. It spans transactions, budgets, expenses with receipt upload, payments/vendors, onboarding and webhook registration. A maintained changelog, Postman collections, an llms.txt index and an official MCP server round it out for agent use. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a standard path (the probe returned 404 at common locations, though OpenAPI-based reference docs exist).
